newsitem.title: USA: Perot said will name running mate Tuesday night.
newsitem.headline: Perot said will name running mate Tuesday night.

text.p: Texas billionare and Reform Party presidential candidate Ross Perot said Monday he will announce his choice for a vice presidential running mate Tuesday night during a 30-minute advertising program that he has purchased on the CBS television network.
Perot disclosed his plans for the announcement during a lunch speech to the Economic Club of Detroit.
The television program, according to Perot's campaign workers in Michigan, will air at 8 p.m. EDT (2400 GMT) Tuesday on CBS.

In addition to revealing his running mate, Perot said he also will outline his proposals for overhauling the federal government's Medicare and Medicaid programs and will discuss other economic issues.

Responding to questions about his running mate, Perot said it will be "Somebody who has the background, the experience and qualifications and more than anything else, the guts and integrity to deal with this."
He declined to elaborate further on whether his choice is an elected official, a man or a woman. With a wave of his hand and a grin, he said, "Tune in tomorrow night."
